programmes.t: Billionaire Dad Won't Support His Kid
programmes.d: Arrogant real estate mogul Ethan faces public backlash. To salvage his image, he agrees to a PR stunt, spending 24 hours handcuffed to a homeless man, Sam, who is secretly a renowned artist. This forced connection transforms Ethan's perspective.

programmes.t: Boy Gets Adopted by His Bully's Family
programmes.d: When a high school bully realizes the foster teen moving into his home is his classmate, he tries to frame him—only to discover the boy's late mother previously saved his life, sparking a redemption.

programmes.t: Girl Wakes Up as Most Hated Student
programmes.d: When her mean private texts leak, popular Addison loses her friends. After cheating to win Homecoming Queen, she confesses publicly and reconciles with her ex-best friend, Ruby.

programmes.t: Popular Girl Only Has All Robot Friends
programmes.d: Tired of being rejected, brilliant student Brielle builds a squad of perfect robot best friends. But when the AI turns against her to expose the whole school, she must team up with her human ex-BFF.

programmes.t: Kids Cheat Mrbeast For $1 Million
programmes.d: Dhar Mann challenges fans to meet MrBeast for $1M. Mikey and Jay cheat through the games but get busted, leaving honest Derek to win. The sore losers go out with a bang, ruining the finale by pieing MrBeast and Jay Shetty in front of everyone.

programmes.t: Kid Completes 100 Dares In 24 Hours
programmes.d: After accepting a $100 dare, Nathan completes 100 gross and embarrassing challenges set by Colin. When Nathan finishes, Colin admits he never had the money. Bruno, whom Nathan dared to mess with, confronts Colin, who runs off, and Omar buys the Airpods Nathan took as "payback" for the $100.

programmes.t: Kid Chooses Cool Guys Over Friends
programmes.d: Middle schooler Jay, hoping to impress his cousin Tiffany, ditches his friends to play basketball with high schoolers who only want him to get close to Tiffany. Jay's friends expose the truth, leading to an epic basketball showdown.

programmes.t: Parents & Kids Switch Lives For 24 Hours
programmes.d: Teen siblings Brooklyn and Will swap lives with their parents to prove whose life is harder. The kids struggle with adult responsibilities, and the parents find school stressful, leading them to call off the switch.

programmes.t: Kid Won't Listen To His Mother
programmes.d: Jay avoids his mother's rules, leading her to use reverse psychology. He overhears the plan but falls for a real kidnapper. He then uses reverse psychology to escape and is saved by police, but doesn't change.

programmes.t: Kid Changes His Grades By Hacking
programmes.d: Hacker Ted changes his grades to A's for money. The plan backfires when he's forced into an Academic Bowl and exposes his own ignorance. To avoid expulsion, he must fix the security system, ultimately losing his cash to the angry students he scammed.

programmes.t: Surviving the World's Worst College Roommate
programmes.d: After messy Maya pushes studious Rosie too far, a "taste of her own medicine" plan humbles Maya. The duo forms a bond, working together to improve their grades and share responsibilities.

programmes.t: Unlikely Romances Presented by Dhar Mann Studios: Checkmate
programmes.d: Nathan plans to dismantle the cheer squad by seducing its captain, Brooke. He falls for her instead, leading them both to break free from social boxes and find real love.

programmes.t: Unlikely Romances Presented By Dhar Mann Studios
programmes.d: To avoid deportation, Indian caterer Raj enters a fake marriage with his employee Simone. Despite a suspicious agent and Raj's mom, the two find real love as Raj bonds with Simone's young son.

programmes.t: Unlikely Romances Presented By Dhar Mann Studios
programmes.st: Billionaire Wife & Pool Boy Fall In Love
programmes.d: Claire, a billionaire's wife, leaves her toxic husband for high school love Lucas. Together, they fight a rigged custody battle, expose Richard's lies, and build a successful new life from scratch.

programmes.d: Ms. Klemper, a militant vegan teacher, rigs a school vote to ban meat following her brother's death. After her extreme methods cause a riot, she learns that forced change only breeds resentment.

programmes.t: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
programmes.d: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.

programmes.t: Fighting Siblings Ruin Thanksgiving
programmes.d: Siblings Randle and Jessie drop the turkey in a mop bucket and steal a replacement from a lady at the store. Their cover is blown when the victim arrives at dinner as their dad's secretary.

programmes.t: Girl Goes Viral Then Her Family Controls Her Life
programmes.d: After going viral for her dancing, Sara's struggling family tries to turn her success into a monetized brand, forcing her to choose between financial fame and her dream dance audition.

programmes.t: 13-Year-Old Obsessed with VR
programmes.d: Juvenile delinquent Mikey schemes to steal church offerings, but a real thief gets there first. When the money goes missing, Mikey helps expose the deceitful Pastor, earns a reward, and uses it to help a sick child.

programmes.t: Teen's First Job Goes Very Wrong
programmes.d: Teen Lamar attempts dangerous TikTok stunts to gain followers and win Lisa's attention. A near-fatal challenge lands him in the hospital, forcing him to shift his focus to mental health and genuine connection, leading to real success.

programmes.t: Problem Child Gets World's Strictest Babysitter
programmes.d: After Sasha hangs a bully from a flagpole, her father hires a strict babysitter to discipline her. Sasha tries to rebel, but eventually learns respect before being sent to live in a tiny house.

programmes.t: Two School Pranksters Go Way Too Far
programmes.d: After their mean pranks go too far, pranksters Frank and Jake are forced by their victims to change their ways. They start a viral "kindness prank" channel, proving that humor can be used for good.

programmes.t: Genius Boy Is Kicked Out From Party
programmes.d: Competitive mom Brenda bans Jayden from her son's party for being "too good" at everything. After guests boycott her event for Jayden's, the moms realize kids' friendships shouldn't suffer for parent petty rivalries.

programmes.t: Kid Steals First Ever PlayStation 6, He Lives to Regret It
programmes.d: Eddy breaks into a store to steal a PS6, but only snags an empty display box. After leaving his backpack behind, he's arrested and loses the real console his mom had already hidden for him.

programmes.t: Mean Girls Make Fun of Small Gymnast
programmes.d: Struggling with the loss of her mother, gymnast Ava faces mental blocks and bullies at regionals. With support from her father and Salish Matter, she learns that true victory is never giving up.

programmes.t: Teen Interns With Billionaire on Spring Break
programmes.d: A broke teen lands a spring break job with a reclusive billionaire, but risks losing his girlfriend and family chasing wealth, until his boss's regrets teach him what truly matters.

programmes.t: Mom Leaves Family After Winning the Lottery
programmes.d: A hardworking mom secretly wins $10 million, gives her family spending money and disappears, letting them learn through chaos, bad choices, and consequences why her rules always mattered.

programmes.t: She Hid Her Face for 10 Years
programmes.d: Mira hides facial burn scars behind a mask, while pageant queen Aubri hides under heavy makeup. The two form an unlikely bond, choosing authenticity over parental pressure and finding acceptance

programmes.t: Toxic Friends Don't Know Friend Is Secretly Famous
programmes.d: After being bullied for his weight and mocked for his dream of stand-up, lawyer Jonah quits his job. Guided by comedian Lauren, he finds success and proves his toxic friends and ex-girlfriend wrong.

programmes.t: Girl Is Dumped Then Becomes a Millionaire
programmes.d: After her fiancé Alex fires her and leaves her for her best friend, Hannah seeks revenge by teaming up with his estranged brother, Logan. She finds true success and love where she least expected it.

programmes.t: Girl Hides Homeless Kid in Closet
programmes.d: After finding a homeless classmate in her closet, wealthy Savannah exposes her mother's harmful evictions, inspiring real compassion that repays an old debt of kindness.

programmes.t: Dad Fakes as Celebrity to See His Kids
programmes.d: To impress his kids and outshine their new stepdad, a struggling father fakes a celebrity connection to sneak backstage. After getting caught, he learns that simply showing up is what truly matters.

programmes.t: Dad Trains His Son to Be Like Lionel Messi
programmes.d: Overwhelmed by his father's relentless pressure to become the next Lionel Messi for online clout, a talented young soccer player stands up for himself and discovers his true passion lies in coaching.

programmes.t: Girl Discovers Her Whole Life Is a Reality Show
programmes.d: When teen Sophie gets a phone, her popular friends secretly film her private life for a paid reality show. After discovering their secret cameras, she exposes their betrayal in court.

programmes.t: Cheer Team Erases Girl From Yearbook
programmes.d: Erased from her cheer team's yearbook photo, Faith demands a fair tryout. Overcoming sabotage, she earns her squad's respect and takes center stage in an updated, inclusive photo.

programmes.t: Billionaire Goes Broke in College
programmes.d: When spoiled heiress Alessia's accounts are frozen, she fakes wealth to join a sorority. But when a friend frames her broke roommate Maya for theft, Alessia chooses true character over status.

programmes.t: Homeless Teen Wins $1 Million in Game Show
programmes.d: After his guardian locks him away to help a rival win, homeless teen Samir escapes to compete in a game show. Using his father's wisdom, he wins $1M and reunites with his dad while his abuser is jailed.

programmes.t: Kid Steals Tickets At Fun Center
programmes.d: Teens Mikey and Jay cheat to win a video game convention pass at a birthday party. Their scheme is exposed, but not before their moms overhear, resulting in both boys being punished and learning a hard lesson.

programmes.t: Kids Build Secret Gaming Room To Hide From Mom
programmes.d: Jay tricks his mom into taking a vacation so he can build a secret gaming room. His plan succeeds until his mom's early return exposes his lies, leading to a hilarious punishment that teaches him a valuable lesson in honesty.

programmes.t: Sisters Compete For Boy's Love
programmes.d: Carter uses sweet, nerdy Tara to make his crush, Sara, jealous. When Sara's cruel nature is revealed, Carter realizes his mistake, choosing Tara's genuine kindness. He publicly rejects Sara, embracing authenticity and a heartfelt Valentine's Day with Tara.

programmes.t: 14-Year-Old Won't Listen To His Mom
programmes.d: Teen basketball star Jay takes his mom for granted, missing promises and a game. To teach him a lesson, his mom does the same to him. Jay learns the importance of reliability and showing up for others.

programmes.t: Adult Must Go Back To 5TH Grade
programmes.d: Disrespectful executive Amir must pass the 5th grade to keep his job, a challenge made tougher by his bully's father, Phillip. With his nephew's help, Amir proves his intelligence, exposing Phillip's hypocrisy and securing his own future.

programmes.t: Kid Falls For Nerdy Girl From A Bet
programmes.d: Lazy but charismatic teen Jay cheats to win a tablet, using shy Gretchen as a pawn. When Gretchen discovers his deceit, she publicly challenges him. Jay's honest feelings surface during a dance battle, proving genuine connection is better than a game.

programmes.t: Neighbors Won't Stop Fighting
programmes.d: Rival mothers Cecilia and Elizabeth engage in a relentless feud of one-upmanship, forcing their kids, Josh and Hazel, to sneak around to date. Exposed at a school formal, the moms' rivalry unravels, revealing their mutual insecurities and paving the way for reconciliation.

programmes.t: Teens Turn 21-Years-Ols For 24 Hours
programmes.d: Three immature teens get a taste of adult freedom with a credit card, but their reckless spending and actions quickly land them in trouble with the law. They escape punishment, but a final VR prank reveals they still have much to learn.

programmes.t: Kid Cheats In School Fundraiser
programmes.d: Determined to win a Go Kart, competitive teen Eddie cheats in a school fundraiser, lying about sales and rigging the final count. His victory is short-lived when his deceit is exposed, costing him the prize and earning him detention.

programmes.t: Girl's ChatGPT Leaked Last Day at School
programmes.d: Forced to wear badges of their GPAs, failing artist Isa and overachiever Brielle team up to replace public shaming with a supportive peer tutoring program.

programmes.t: Girl Forced Extreme Diet to Win Comp
programmes.d: After being body-shamed and starved by her ruthless coach, Emma joins a rival team that prioritizes health over winning. Her fueled performance proves that well-being is the true key to success.

programmes.t: Student Vandalizes Principal's Car
programmes.d: Adam is framed for vandalizing the principal's car using deepfake technology. He discovers his nerdy classmate William used AI to frame him out of love for Adam's girlfriend, Julia.

programmes.t: Teen Shamed for Mom's Mistake
programmes.d: When teacher Rebecca is blamed for a student's DUI crash, her son Marcus faces relentless shaming. He and his girlfriend Sofia uncover a police cover-up, clear her name, and expose the corruption.

programmes.t: Mexican Girl Shamed for Bad Spanish
programmes.d: Shamed for her poor Spanish, adopted teen Sofia hides her white parents from her boyfriend's traditional family. When exposed, she embraces her true biological heritage, dumps her boyfriend, and finds pride.

programmes.d: Popular Jenna stages her kidnapping to escape the pressure of perfection. Classmate Eli, recognizing her hidden depression from his late sister's tragedy, saves her on a cliff edge just in time.

programmes.t: Rich Girl Goes Undercover As Normal Girl
programmes.d: A pampered princess, arranged to marry a superficial prince, seeks freedom in America. There, she falls for a humble, kind boy and learns to stand up for herself, ultimately breaking free from tradition and finding true love.

programmes.d: A talented singer in a cruel foster home, Zara's dreams are crushed by her foster sister Fallyn. But with a new friend and popstar Jace's support, Zara finds her voice, exposes Fallyn's deceit, and achieves stardom.

programmes.d: Desperate to revive his YouTube channel, Timmy prioritizes collabs with Allison Day over his girlfriend Trish, even missing her birthday. After hitting 10 million subs, he realizes his self-absorption, apologizes, and offers to pay for Trish's dream art school tuition and move to New York with her.

programmes.d: Grace and her mother Tracy face homelessness and bullying while Grace insists on wearing her late father's firefighter jacket. She eventually reveals he died saving her classmates' families.

programmes.t: Overlooked Little Person Becomes Fashion Star
programmes.d: After her sister Madison claims she'll never model, Aria, a woman with dwarfism, lands a major casting call. Despite industry cruelty, she proves her talent, earns her sister's support, and shines.

programmes.d: Mikey scams viewers by having his brother, Jayden, play Minecraft on his stream, taking all the credit and money. His deception unravels at a fan event when he can't play himself, exposing his fraud. Jayden then gains recognition, leaving Mikey to face the consequences.

programmes.t: Employee Fakes Sick To Skip Work
programmes.d: Jacob, a compulsive liar, fakes his grandma's death to skip work for a date with his boss's daughter, Nicole. His web of lies unravels when both grandmas appear, exposing his deceit and costing him his job, his girlfriend, and his dignity.

programmes.d: Tim, a spoiled teen, cheats on his driving test using his dad's Tesla, but his schemes unravel. After hitting a car and failing, he's arrested, and his furious dad refuses bail, leaving Tim to face the consequences alone.

programmes.t: Kid Chooses Treasure Over Friends
programmes.d: Three friends embark on a treasure hunt, hoping to solve their money problems. They face challenges and temptations, ultimately realizing that true wealth lies not in riches but in the bond of their friendship.

programmes.d: After being kicked out for his dedication to acting, Alex disguises himself as a nanny to be near his kids. He must then contend with his wife's new boyfriend and the challenges of being a nanny. When his cover is blown, he must decide between his career and his family.

programmes.d: Aspiring gamer Jordan resorts to cheating, using aimbots to win a Call of Duty tournament and impress his crush. His deceit unravels during the finals when his cheat fails, exposing his lies and leading to public humiliation.

programmes.d: Megan and Rob, lifelong best friends, constantly fight, hiding their true feelings. When their insecurities and past traumas lead them apart, they confront their fears and reunite, realizing their love was always there, just masked by fear.

programmes.t: Siblings Who Date Sisters
programmes.d: Daisy falls for Max, who, influenced by his brother Andy, treats her cruelly. When Andy's actions lead to his arrest, Max, realizing his mistake, apologizes to Daisy, embracing kindness and pursuing her genuinely.

programmes.t: Guy Dates Four Girls At Once
programmes.d: After discovering her boyfriend's betrayal, Cassidy seeks revenge by manipulating multiple guys. Her plan backfires publicly, leading to humiliation and the loss of the one genuine connection. Ultimately, she seeks redemption, learning that honesty and vulnerability lead to true happiness.

programmes.t: Boyfriend Framed For Cheating
programmes.d: Amy worries her long-distance boyfriend, David, will cheat in college. Tara, a jealous classmate, tries to sabotage their relationship with misleading photos. However, Amy and David's trust prevails when a "live photo" reveals the truth, leading to Amy's college acceptance and their enduring love.

programmes.t: Girl Denies Nerd In Front Of School
programmes.d: Arrogant Raji snubs Mario, her secret admirer, for popular Davis. After a disastrous Valentine's date exposes Davis's true colors and leaves her with a huge bill, Raji learns humility and accepts Mario's kindness.

programmes.t: Nerdy Kid Becomes Basketball Champion
programmes.d: A former NBA player, Darrell, loses his way after an injury, facing unemployment, a breakup, and a DUI. Sentenced to coach a neurodivergent high school basketball team, he finds redemption, reconnects with his passion, and rebuilds his life.

programmes.t: Girl Fakes as Sabrina Carpenter to Sneak Into Concert
programmes.d: After her dad can't afford concert tickets, Harper disguises herself as Sabrina Carpenter to sneak in. She realizes the value of family over fake friends and ends up hired as the star's official double.

programmes.t: Pop the Balloon Show Turned Into Her Worst Day
programmes.d: Jules enters a dating show looking for love but finds only clout-chasers. After a cruel betrayal by a contestant, she nearly gets crushed by an AC unit—only to be saved by her true soulmate, Ro.

programmes.t: Kid Builds Secret Tunnel To School
programmes.d: Jay, now a social media star, gets suspended, leading him to prank his new principal. His pranks backfire as a strict new principal takes over, trapping students. Jay and his friends unite, digging an escape tunnel, and restoring order to the school.

programmes.t: Kid Gets World's Strictest Family
programmes.d: Sasha, a rebellious teen, is sent to her aunt and uncle's mansion for a "vacation" to learn discipline. Tricked into babysitting her conniving cousin Pearl, Sasha faces escalating pranks and blackmail, ultimately leading to a chaotic party and a shocking twist.

programmes.t: Adult Poses As High Schooler
programmes.d: After his wife files for divorce, Ralph, a timid husband, undergoes a transformative experience, gaining the courage to stand up for himself, his children, and his marriage, ultimately winning back his family and a long-overdue promotion.

programmes.t: Girl Bullied for Being Wrestler
programmes.d: Riley secretly wrestles while her mother pushes for a traditional life. After her boyfriend issues an ultimatum, she chooses her dream, earns her mother's support, and begins training with a pro.

programmes.t: Teacher Gets Revenge on School Bully
programmes.d: After his teacher helps him transform from a scrawny victim to a confident student, Miles realizes his bully, Grant, is hiding a painful home life. Miles records evidence of Grant's abusive stepfather, helping Grant find safety and redemption.

programmes.t: Scrawny Teen Takes Pills to Beat Bully
programmes.d: Scrawny Ethan is pressured to take steroids by a corrupt coach. Choosing hard work over shortcuts, he trains with the school janitor to beat his bully in a showdown and expose the coach's crimes.

programmes.t: 10-Year-Old Genius Kid Takes CEO's Job
programmes.d: Grady, a grumpy veteran ad executive, is replaced by a 10-year-old child prodigy CEO. After a fierce rivalry, Grady learns modern tech while the boy realizes he just wants to be a normal kid.

programmes.t: Poor Girl's Gift Shamed at Birthday Party
programmes.d: Poor immigrant Mateo sells blood to buy his daughter a dress for a rich friend's party. After an attorney discovers Mateo's tragic past and workplace abuse, he helps reunite the family in the USA.

programmes.t: Musician Tricks Girl To Pay Bills
programmes.d: Jack uses his rich girlfriend, Angela, for money, lying to her and flaunting it to his bandmates. But Angela uncovers his deceit through various clues. She confronts him, dumps him, and takes back control of the festival tickets she bought, leaving Jack with a broken car and no guitar.

programmes.t: Cheerleaders Don't Know Nerd Is Legend
programmes.d: Ally, a quirky new student, tries to fit in by suppressing her true self, but a cruel prank exposes her "weirdness." Heartbroken, she almost gives up, until her idol, Harper Zilmer, encourages her. Embracing her authentic self, Ally thrives, even attending the spring fling with Harper as her date.

programmes.t: Roommate Sabotages Guys Date
programmes.d: Sam plans an elaborate Valentine's Day for Tyra, but his jealous roommate Chad sabotages everything. Despite the mishaps, Tyra is touched by Sam's thoughtful, homemade gifts, ultimately choosing his genuine affection over Chad's flashy but deceitful gestures.

programmes.t: Tinder Date Takes Money
programmes.d: Shailene falls for Omer, a charming billionaire heir she met online, and loans him money. When she discovers he's a "Tinder Swindler" conning women, Shailene, with her friends, devises a plan to get revenge and expose him.

programmes.t: Girl Takes Best Friend's Boyfriend
programmes.d: At an elite school, scholarship student Grace challenges the "R3" rich bullies. After they retaliate, she uncovers a softer side to their leader, Benny, and inspires him to change, leading to a surprising romance.

programmes.t: Kid Makes Plane Land to Skip Test
programmes.d: To skip a school test, Mikey fakes a security threat on an airplane, causing a federal emergency. His plan backfires when his mother is arrested for his crime, forcing him to confess and face juvenile detention.

programmes.t: Kids Live In Hoarding House
programmes.d: Dean, an artist in a hoarded home, is bullied by Orlando. After Dean saves Orlando's grandfather, they bond over family trauma. Orlando helps clean Dean's house to thwart CPS. Dean wins the art show.

programmes.t: Mom Doesn't Want Baby With Disability
programmes.d: Fearing her newborn might be blind, Rose secretly swaps her for a healthy infant. Years later, Marcus discovers the truth through a chance encounter and a DNA test. Rose is arrested, and the two families unite to raise both daughters, eventually reconnecting with Rose's estranged, blind mother.

programmes.t: Kid Breaks Every Rule to Be Genius
programmes.d: After years of bullying and academic failure, Bernie, a student with dyslexia, solves an "unsolvable" equation. He overcomes his stepfamily's discouragement to earn a full scholarship to Stanford.

programmes.t: Students Don't Know Teacher Is Secretly Princess
programmes.d: A hidden princess teaching at an inner-city school is exposed. Though her family tries to force her home, her students' love convinces the Queen to let her stay and become the school's principal.

programmes.t: Son Discovers Mom Has Only 30 Days to Live
programmes.d: Drew Binsky, obsessed with travel since childhood, shocks his parents by announcing he will travel the world instead of pursuing a traditional career. After his savings run out, his girlfriend, Deanna, helps him launch a successful vlogging career, eventually paying off his parents' home.

programmes.t: Parents Force Kid Into Being Child Star
programmes.d: Greedy adoptive parents exploit 12-year-old Dylan for fame and fortune. After a social worker uncovers their abuse and forgery, they are arrested, allowing Dylan to finally live a normal life.

programmes.t: Girl Takes Lip Filler Way Too Far
programmes.d: Insecure about her thin lips, Millie blows her savings on fillers but, unsatisfied, gets a dangerous, "cheap" procedure. After a severe infection, she learns that true beauty comes from within.

programmes.t: Kid Cheats In School Fundraiser
programmes.d: Determined to win a Go Kart, competitive teen Eddie cheats in a school fundraiser, lying about sales and rigging the final count. His victory is short-lived when his deceit is exposed, costing him the prize and earning him detention.

programmes.t: Kid Fakes Injury To Play Basketball
programmes.d: After insulting his instructors, cocky teen coder Kyle is forced to teach for a week. When his arrogance causes classroom disasters—including a science lab fire—he must rely on his computer teacher for help, learning a humble lesson about respect and hard work.

programmes.t: Kid Gets Expelled From School
programmes.d: Teen prankster Jay sneaks into a diner during a real hostage situation. His quick thinking and prank props help thwart the criminals. Seeing the consequences of bad choices firsthand, Jay vows to turn his life around.

programmes.t: Streamer Pranked On Live Stream
programmes.d: Competitive teen Hannah sabotages her friends' Minecraft build-off to win the prize money for her struggling mom. Exposed, her friends forgive her, giving her the prize money and a new start, recognizing her good intentions.

programmes.t: Adult Wants To Stay Adult Forever
programmes.d: Child actor Brent, unwilling to age out of his famous role, faces rejection in Hollywood. Broke and desperate, he takes a diner job, where a chance encounter with his childhood idol inspires him to embrace maturity and pursue new acting dreams.

programmes.t: Birthday Party Changes Girl's Life Forever
programmes.d: Envious magician Marvin sabotages rival Princess Wanda's party, only to find himself unexpectedly filling in as her unicorn sidekick. Their accidental collaboration leads to unforeseen success, forcing them to embrace teamwork and a new magical partnership.

programmes.t: Kid Builds Waterpark In House
programmes.d: Jay plans an epic waterpark party for Gretchen's birthday to impress her, but it gets busted by the cops. Despite the chaos, Gretchen is touched by his thoughtfulness, and they become a couple, much to their parents' amusement.

programmes.t: Hospital Gives Baby to Wrong Mom and Dad
programmes.d: After a hospital mix-up is revealed, quiet Nadia and energetic Ava swap families to find their "true" fit. They soon realize biology doesn't beat sixteen years of love and choose to return home.

programmes.d: To win over his crush, foster youth Soren conquers five trials set by her exes. After passing, he realizes his birth mother doesn't want him, but finds real love in his best friend Margot, joining her flight to stay together.

programmes.t: Girl Mocked for Thrifting Becomes CEO

programmes.d: Neglected foster child Andrew longs for a family. His foster siblings, Derek and Erica, track down his birth mom using a DNA kit and a viral TikTok video, reuniting the mother and son for Christmas.

programmes.t: Vegan Teacher Bans All Meat on Thanksgiving
programmes.d: Ms. Klemper, a militant vegan teacher, rigs a school vote to ban meat following her brother's death. After her extreme methods cause a riot, she learns that forced change only breeds resentment.

programmes.t: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
programmes.d: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.

programmes.t: Fighting Siblings Ruin Thanksgiving
programmes.d: Siblings Randle and Jessie drop the turkey in a mop bucket and steal a replacement from a lady at the store. Their cover is blown when the victim arrives at dinner as their dad's secretary.

programmes.t: Girl Goes Viral Then Her Family Controls Her Life
programmes.d: After going viral for her dancing, Sara's struggling family tries to turn her success into a monetized brand, forcing her to choose between financial fame and her dream dance audition.

programmes.t: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
programmes.d: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

programmes.t: Bully Doesn't Know Girl Has a Huge Secret
programmes.d: Maggie bullies Kelly, unaware she has leukemia. After her insults force Kelly out of the school play, Maggie learns the truth. Horrified, she brings the performance to Kelly's hospital room, proving that kindness matters and everyone faces battles.

programmes.t: AI Teachers Run The School
programmes.d: After a vivid nightmare of robot teachers, Zoe and her friends plot to oust their strict English teacher, Mrs. Bryson. Their pranks backfire when AI robots replace the faculty, causing chaos until the students unite to expose the corrupt principal and bring back their beloved teacher.

programmes.t: Teen Sent To Boot Camp
programmes.d: Mischievous teen Danny's pranks land him in a reform camp that secretly brainwashes kids. He uncovers the truth with a friend, escapes, and exposes the corrupt doctor, ultimately finding redemption and repairing his family relationships.

programmes.t: Student Takes IQ Serum To Impress Girl
programmes.d: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.
